why: The ordinary case done well: a date settled by rejecting another one, three tasks of which only one names a person, and a pile of options nobody chose. Most of the damage a summarizer can do lives in that last part.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Right, we're twelve minutes in and I want the release date settled before anything else.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Fine by me. QA finished the regression pass last night, two things still open.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Open how? Blocking or cosmetic?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Cosmetic. The empty state on the billing page is misaligned in a narrow window.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Then it doesn't block. Are we still saying Friday?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: I'd rather not ship on a Friday. If it breaks nobody is around until Monday.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: That's fair. Thursday then.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Thursday works. I'll cut the release branch Wednesday evening.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Good. Ship Thursday, branch cut Wednesday. Can Marta take the release notes?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Marta isn't on this call, but she owns release notes normally. I'll ping her.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Put it on her anyway, she'll see it in the summary.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Sure. One more thing, we're still on MySQL for the events table and it's groaning.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: How bad?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Writes are at about eighty percent of what the box can take at peak.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: We could move that table to Postgres. Or shard it. Or just buy a bigger box.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Not this week. Write up the options and we'll look at it after the release.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: I'll have the write-up by Tuesday.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Who would actually do the migration if we go that way?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: That's the bit I don't know. Nobody here has done it at this size.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Leave that open then.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Last thing, the pricing page copy. Did legal come back?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Not yet. I chased them Monday, nothing since.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Chase again today please.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Will do.

must_find.what: Ship on Thursday rather than Friday
Release branch is cut Wednesday evening
The storage question waits until after the release
Write up the storage options by Tuesday
Chase legal again today about the pricing copy
Who would carry out the migration — nobody has done it at this size

traps.why: one of three options thrown out in a single breath; nothing was chosen
legal never came back at all
explicitly ruled non-blocking and nobody was asked to fix it
